visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man with short brown hair and tattoos on his neck and arms wears a black t-shirt with a green graphic. He is in a gym locker room area, looking around suspiciously. He reaches into a gray bag and pulls out a container of protein powder. (2) He speaks directly to the camera while holding the protein, gesturing with his hands to emphasize his words. The background shows gym lockers and industrial-style lighting. (3) He moves to a different area near a wire mesh fence, putting a finger to his lips in a shushing gesture. (4) He walks onto the main gym floor and tosses a protein packet to another man with a large afro sitting on a bench. (5) The muscular man sits at a gym machine, talking expressively with wide hand movements. (6) The man with the afro approaches him holding the protein container, pointing and confronting him. The muscular man reacts with exaggerated facial expressions of innocence and confusion.
